questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Snow : Mountain :: Sand : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Location or Place where the material is commonly found**.

Here,

Snow : Mountain → **Snow** is commonly found in **Mountains**.

Similarly,

Sand : Beach → **Sand** is commonly found in **Beaches**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65fc24f39f82639611e7cc0ac86d8bb7964bc358777c9c818904e390ec6e44f5.png]
questions.solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = Total triangles

= [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2

= [2 × 3] ÷ 2

= 6 ÷ 2

= 3

Here, as there are 4 same parts, therefore '3 × 4' = 12 triangles<

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All peacocks are lion.

Some lions are dogs.

No dog is a cat.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some lions are not cats.

II. Some peacocks are dogs.

III. Some peacocks are not lion.

options.text: Conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusion II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1cdb115292b74293e6e99a6af802c8dd6afc6319f6d305fd79c3a4e862b8838.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some lions are not cats → Follow (As some lions are dogs and no dog is a cat. As some part of lions is common with dogs which cannot be cat, therefore it is true.)

II. Some peacocks are dogs → Does not follow (As all peacocks are lion and some lions are dogs. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. Some peacocks are not lion → Does not follow (As all peacocks are lion. As whole peacocks comes in lion, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(49, 12), (81, 14)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number - 5)² = 1st number.

Now,

For, 49 : 12

⇒ (12 - 5)² = 7² = 49.

For, 81 : 14

⇒ (14 - 5)² = 9² = 81.

Similarly, for **361 : 24**

**⇒ (24 - 5)² = 19² = 361.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
